source.content: global class PrivateCorpusAuthShape implements Auth.RegistrationHandler { global User createUser(Id portalId, Auth.UserData data) { return null; } global void updateUser(Id userId, Id portalId, Auth.UserData data) {} public static void compileShape() { Auth.UserData data = new Auth.UserData('id', 'first', 'last', 'full', 'email@example.invalid', 'link', 'username', 'provider', 'en_US', 'site', new Map<String,String>()); Auth.VerificationMethod method = Auth.VerificationMethod.EMAIL; Auth.AuthConfiguration configuration = new Auth.AuthConfiguration('https://community.example.invalid', '/start'); Auth.VerificationResult verification = new Auth.VerificationResult(new PageReference('/start'), true, 'ok'); Map<String,String> session = Auth.SessionManagement.getCurrentSession(); Boolean revoked = Auth.AuthToken.revokeAccess('provider-id', 'provider', 'user-id', 'remote-id'); System.assert(data != null || method != null || configuration != null || verification != null || session != null || revoked != null); } }
